subject: muscular adult warrior in dark briefs, bare-chested, holding an enormous slab greatsword twice his height with both hands
motion: Heavy two-handed sword swing: wind-up overhead, diagonal downward slash, low follow-through, return to ready.
facing: in a three-quarter fighting stance facing screen-left
effects: a glowing purple magic trail following the blade's path, and a white air-cut arc at the moment of the slash

plan.source: Facing left in 3/4, wide stance: left foot forward and right back; torso braced; right hand grips pommel by hip, left hand under the guard by cheek; slab greatsword held two‑handed, angled up-left towering overhead.

frames.pose: Anticipation: sink and coil to the right; hips load back. Hands keep the hilt, drawing it near right ear; blade shifts overhead to back-right. Head stays facing left. Right foot planted, left toes pivot light but grounded.
frames.effect: Short purple trail arcing above his head from high-left toward back-right behind the blade, clear of face.

frames.pose: Key: explosive diagonal slash. Weight drives onto left leg; left foot planted, right heel up pivoting. Torso leans forward-left, arms extend; blade sweeps from over-right across front to low-left outside the lead knee.
frames.effect: White air-cut arc from above-right to low-left in front of him; bright and outside silhouette. Purple trail lags along the same path behind the blade.

frames.pose: Follow-through low: sword passes past target; hands down near left thigh, tip forward-left low. Torso folded over left. Left foot still planted; right toes skid forward slightly, heel up.
frames.effect: Purple trail low-left, curling just behind the tip along the continuing arc near the ground; no air-cut.

frames.pose: Recovery: lift blade back up-left toward ready; hands draw in to chest—left near guard by cheek, right at pommel. Torso rises and recenters. Left foot planted; right foot steps back and plants.
frames.effect: Faint purple trail rising from low-left toward up-left along the lift path, kept to the outer left edge.
